01.title: Initial AI Briefing
01.text: With our AI assistant, you describe the initial scope of your idea so we can collect the first briefing and understand the business context.

02.title: Planning Call
02.text: You schedule a call with our AI-assisted process so we can refine the plan, discuss ideas, define priorities, and shape the budget.

03.title: Design & Delivery
03.text: We start development with key stages shared for your review, including follow-up meetings and iteration rounds until delivery.

01.question: Where can our projects be hosted?
01.answer: The infrastructure is fully adaptable. Projects can be deployed on cloud platforms, dedicated servers, the client's own infrastructure, or another environment required by the project.

02.question: What does your delivery include?
02.answer: Our work can cover the entire process, from the initial idea to development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. We can also adapt the delivery model to the client's specific structure and requirements.

03.question: How does the development process work?
03.answer: The process is divided into three simple stages:

steps.01: The client completes an initial briefing with our AI agent.
steps.02: We schedule a call to align requirements, details, scope, and budget.
steps.03: We develop, deliver, and deploy the solution.

04.question: Can you integrate the project with our existing systems?
04.answer: Yes. We can integrate solutions through APIs, MCP, webhooks, databases, third-party platforms, or other formats required by the client's infrastructure.

05.question: How does communication work across different time zones?
05.answer: We are fully aligned with American time zones and friendly to European schedules. We normally recommend meetings during the European afternoon, but extended or 24-hour availability can be discussed for specific projects.

06.question: Do you provide support after delivery?
06.answer: Yes. Support requirements are defined according to each project's complexity and operational needs. Regular support can be provided through a monthly maintenance plan.

07.question: How do you ensure application security?
07.answer: Projects go through technical testing and specialized security reviews, following established market practices for architecture, access control, credentials, integrations, dependencies, and data protection.

08.question: Why hire your agency instead of a European agency?
08.answer: We combine quality, efficient delivery, integrated services, and a more accessible operational structure. This allows us to deliver high-value solutions with a favorable balance between expertise, quality, and cost, supported by the multidisciplinary experience of our founder.

09.question: Does a more competitive price mean lower quality?
09.answer: No. Quality, engineering, and security come first. Our pricing is more competitive because we use AI efficiently to optimize research, development, testing, and documentation while preserving human oversight, functionality, and professional standards.

legal.title: CriativAI Privacy & Terms
legal.privacyOne: CriativAI uses contact, chat, form, and calendar information only to respond to requests, support scheduling, and provide the services chosen by the user.
legal.privacyTwo: When Google Calendar is connected, CriativAI may check availability and create, update, or cancel calendar events with Google Meet links. Calendar data is used only for scheduling and is not sold.
legal.privacyThree: Access tokens and operational data are stored only as needed to run the service. Access can be revoked by disconnecting the app from the Google account permissions page or by contacting CriativAI.
legal.termsOne: By using CriativAI, you agree to use the site and scheduling features lawfully and only for legitimate business communication.
legal.termsTwo: AI-generated responses and scheduling suggestions should be reviewed before relying on them for final business decisions. CriativAI may update or disable features to improve reliability, security, or compliance.
legal.termsThree: For privacy, terms, or data access questions, contact bruno@criativai.site.
